name: google-cloud-monitoring
description: Query Google Cloud metrics with PromQL, review alerts and policies, and browse dashboards

setup.notice: Google does not support automatic client registration. You must provide your own OAuth client credentials.
steps: In the Google Cloud console, enable the Cloud Monitoring API
Grant everyone who will connect the MCP Tool User role (roles/mcp.toolUser)
Add Devin's OAuth callback URL as an authorized redirect URI
Enter the OAuth client ID and secret when installing this server
